title: Working calendars ④: approval escalation clock key (wall_clock | working_time)
body:
③ maintainer-directed task · Source: maintainer ruling on #35340 (comment https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/35340#issuecomment-7000950747; sub-cards approved 2026-11-19 06:03Z 「同意」「都是 p1」).

**Blocked by #35354** (ADR) and the calendar service in ②. Ships in the same release as ② and ③.

## 维护者速读
- **问题：** 审批超时 `timeoutHours` 按自然小时算，夜里、周末、节假日都算进去。
- **要做：** 给审批升级加一个时钟选项，可以按工作时间算。
- **不做会怎样：** 周五下午提交的审批周五晚上就升级，客户看到的到期时间不对。
- **你要做的：** 无。

## Scope
- `ApprovalEscalationSchema` (`packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts` ~855-875): add `clock: 'wall_clock' | 'working_time'` (default `wall_clock`) and optional `calendar` (code). Rewrite the `timeoutHours` describe text and the code comment that say the platform ships no calendar.
- Default stays `wall_clock`: the sweep reads stored node-config snapshots (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` ~8055), so existing requests keep their deadlines.
- Sweep: with `working_time`, compute the deadline from `created_at` via the calendar service (`addWorkingHours`); recompute each sweep rather than storing it.
- Calendar resolution per the ADR (explicit code → org default → refuse). A `working_time` escalation with no resolvable calendar is a lint/validation error, not a silent wall-clock fallback.
- Studio designer field for the clock and calendar; docs and skills teaching text.
- Only `timeoutHours` gets a clock key; other duration keys are one card each, later.

## Done when
A `working_time` escalation opened Friday 17:00 with 4 hours fires on the next working day per the calendar, including across a holiday and a 调休 make-up Saturday; `wall_clock` behaviour unchanged.

## Non-goals
Flipping the default clock; clock keys on other duration keys.
